+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+constexpr unsigned int kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned int kBlockY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerThread = 2;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerBlock = kBlockY * kYPerThread;
+constexpr unsigned int kZPerBlock = 8;
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                    \
+    do {                                                                                    \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (call);                                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                              \
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__,          \
+                         cudaGetErrorString(cuda_check_error));                             \
+            std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                                        \
+        }                                                                                   \
+    } while (false)

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

 using Real = double;
 
+namespace {

+constexpr unsigned int kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned int kBlockY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerThread = 1;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerBlock = kBlockY * kYPerThread;
+constexpr unsigned int kZPerBlock = 8;
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                    \
+    do {                                                                                    \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (call);                                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                              \
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__,          \
+                         cudaGetErrorString(cuda_check_error));                             \
+            std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                                        \
+        }                                                                                   \
+    } while (false)
+
+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+}  // namespace
+

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+constexpr unsigned int kZPerBlock = 8;

+    do {                                                                                    \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (call);                                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                              \

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+constexpr unsigned int kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned int kBlockY = 8;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerThread = 1;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerBlock = kBlockY * kYPerThread;
+constexpr unsigned int kZPerBlock = 8;
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                    \
+    do {                                                                                    \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (call);                                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                              \
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__,          \
+                         cudaGetErrorString(cuda_check_error));                             \
+            std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                                        \
+        }                                                                                   \
+    } while (false)
+
+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+constexpr unsigned int kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned int kBlockY = 2;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerThread = 1;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerBlock = kBlockY * kYPerThread;
+constexpr unsigned int kZPerBlock = 8;
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                    \
+    do {                                                                                    \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (call);                                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                              \
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__,          \
+                         cudaGetErrorString(cuda_check_error));                             \
+            std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                                        \
+        }                                                                                   \
+    } while (false)

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {

+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);

+constexpr unsigned int kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned int kBlockY = 2;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerThread = 1;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerBlock = kBlockY * kYPerThread;
+constexpr unsigned int kZPerBlock = 16;
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                    \
+    do {                                                                                    \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (call);                                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                              \

+        }                                                                                   \
+    } while (false)

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+constexpr unsigned int kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned int kBlockY = 2;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerThread = 1;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerBlock = kBlockY * kYPerThread;
+constexpr unsigned int kZPerBlock = 16;

+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                    \

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+

+constexpr unsigned int kBlockX = 32;

+constexpr unsigned int kZPerBlock = 4;

+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                    \
+    do {                                                                                    \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (call);                                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                              \

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+}  // namespace

+

+constexpr unsigned int kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned int kBlockY = 2;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerThread = 1;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerBlock = kBlockY * kYPerThread;
+constexpr unsigned int kZPerBlock = 2;
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                    \
+    do {                                                                                    \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (call);                                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                              \
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__,          \
+                         cudaGetErrorString(cuda_check_error));                             \
+            std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                                        \
+        }                                                                                   \
+    } while (false)

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+}  // namespace

 using Real = double;
 
+namespace {

+constexpr unsigned int kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned int kBlockY = 2;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerThread = 1;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerBlock = kBlockY * kYPerThread;
+constexpr unsigned int kZPerBlock = 2;
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                    \
+    do {                                                                                    \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (call);                                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                              \
+            std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__,          \
+                         cudaGetErrorString(cuda_check_error));                             \
+            std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                                        \
+        }                                                                                   \
+    } while (false)

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+}  // namespace
+

+constexpr unsigned int kBlockY = 2;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerThread = 1;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerBlock = kBlockY * kYPerThread;
+constexpr unsigned int kZPerBlock = 2;

+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                    \
+    do {                                                                                    \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (call);                                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                              \

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+// A warp spans X, while each thread computes four adjacent Y values and streams
+// over a short Z slab.  X neighbors come from warp shuffles, internal Y neighbors
+// and previous Z planes stay in registers, substantially reducing memory traffic.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize,
+                   const size_t zChunkCount) {
+    const unsigned int lane = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t xBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX;
+    const size_t remainingX = (nx - 1) - xBegin;
+    const unsigned int validX = static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingX, static_cast<size_t>(kBlockX)));
+    const size_t x = min(xBegin + lane, nx - 2);
+
+    const size_t yBeginRaw =
+        1 + (static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y) * kYPerThread;
+    const size_t yBegin = min(yBeginRaw, ny - 2);
+    const size_t remainingY = yBeginRaw < ny - 1 ? (ny - 1) - yBeginRaw : 0;
+    const unsigned int validY =
+        static_cast<unsigned int>(min(remainingY, static_cast<size_t>(kYPerThread)));
+
+    constexpr unsigned int fullWarpMask = 0xffffffffu;
+
+    for (size_t zChunk = blockIdx.z; zChunk < zChunkCount; zChunk += gridDim.z) {
+        const size_t zBegin = 1 + zChunk * kZPerBlock;
+        const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + kZPerBlock, nz - 1);
+
+        Real below[kYPerThread];
+        Real center[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+        for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+            const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+            const size_t xy = y * nx + x;
+            below[p] = input[(zBegin - 1) * planeSize + xy];
+            center[p] = input[zBegin * planeSize + xy];
+        }
+
+        for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z) {
+            Real above[kYPerThread];
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                const size_t y = min(yBegin + p, ny - 2);
+                above[p] = input[(z + 1) * planeSize + y * nx + x];
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                // Every lane must participate in each sync shuffle, including
+                // lanes outside a partial edge tile.
+                const Real warpLeft = __shfl_up_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                const Real warpRight = __shfl_down_sync(fullWarpMask, center[p], 1);
+                if (lane < validX && p < validY) {
+                    const size_t index = z * planeSize + (yBeginRaw + p) * nx + x;
+
+                    const Real left = lane == 0 ? input[index - 1] : warpLeft;
+                    const Real right = lane + 1 < validX ? warpRight : input[index + 1];
+                    const Real front = p == 0 ? input[index - nx] : center[p - 1];
+                    const Real back = p + 1 < validY ? center[p + 1] : input[index + nx];
+
+                    output[index] =
+                        (center[p] + left + right + front + back + below[p] + above[p]) / 7.0;
+                }
+            }
+
+#pragma unroll
+            for (unsigned int p = 0; p < kYPerThread; ++p) {
+                below[p] = center[p];
+                center[p] = above[p];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+constexpr unsigned int kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned int kBlockY = 2;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerThread = 1;
+constexpr unsigned int kYPerBlock = kBlockY * kYPerThread;
+constexpr unsigned int kZPerBlock = 1;
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                    \
+    do {                                                                                    \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (call);                                        \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                              \

+        }                                                                                   \
