+// X spans a complete warp for coalesced loads. The Y/Z tile gives each block
+// neighbor reuse through the read-only cache while retaining full occupancy.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize) {
+    const unsigned int x = 1 + blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (x >= nx - 1) return;
+
+    const size_t yStart = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t zStart = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    const size_t yStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.y) * gridDim.y;
+    const size_t zStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.z) * gridDim.z;
+
+    // Grid-stride traversal keeps unusually long Y/Z dimensions valid even
+    // beyond CUDA's 65,535-block limits; ordinary benchmark shapes run once.
+    for (size_t z = zStart; z < nz - 1; z += zStride) {
+        for (size_t y = yStart; y < ny - 1; y += yStride) {
+            const size_t index = z * planeSize + y * nx + x;
+            output[index] =
+                (input[index] + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1] + input[index - nx] +
+                 input[index + nx] + input[index - planeSize] + input[index + planeSize]) /
+                7.0;
+        }
+    }
+}

+// X spans a complete warp for coalesced loads. The Y/Z tile gives each block
+// neighbor reuse through the read-only cache while retaining full occupancy.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize) {
+    const unsigned int x = 1 + blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (x >= nx - 1) return;
+
+    const size_t yStart = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t zStart = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    const size_t yStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.y) * gridDim.y;
+    const size_t zStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.z) * gridDim.z;
+
+    // Grid-stride traversal keeps unusually long Y/Z dimensions valid even
+    // beyond CUDA's 65,535-block limits; ordinary benchmark shapes run once.
+    for (size_t z = zStart; z < nz - 1; z += zStride) {
+        for (size_t y = yStart; y < ny - 1; y += yStride) {
+            const size_t index = z * planeSize + y * nx + x;
+            output[index] =
+                (input[index] + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1] + input[index - nx] +
+                 input[index + nx] + input[index - planeSize] + input[index + planeSize]) /
+                7.0;
+        }
+    }

+#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                    \

+// X spans a complete warp for coalesced loads. The Y/Z tile gives each block
+// neighbor reuse through the read-only cache while retaining full occupancy.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize) {
+    const unsigned int x = 1 + blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (x >= nx - 1) return;
+
+    const size_t yStart = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t zStart = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    const size_t yStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.y) * gridDim.y;
+    const size_t zStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.z) * gridDim.z;
+
+    // Grid-stride traversal keeps unusually long Y/Z dimensions valid even
+    // beyond CUDA's 65,535-block limits; ordinary benchmark shapes run once.
+    for (size_t z = zStart; z < nz - 1; z += zStride) {
+        for (size_t y = yStart; y < ny - 1; y += yStride) {
+            const size_t index = z * planeSize + y * nx + x;
+            output[index] =
+                (input[index] + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1] + input[index - nx] +
+                 input[index + nx] + input[index - planeSize] + input[index + planeSize]) /
+                7.0;
+        }
+    }
+}
+

    36	                   Real* __restrict__ output,
    37	                   const size_t nx,
    38	                   const size_t ny,
    39	                   const size_t nz,
    40	                   const size_t planeSize) {
    41	    const unsigned int x = 1 + blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    42	    if (x >= nx - 1) return;
    43	
    44	    const size_t yStart = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
    45	    const size_t zStart = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
    46	    const size_t yStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.y) * gridDim.y;
    47	    const size_t zStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.z) * gridDim.z;
    48	
    49	    // Grid-stride traversal keeps unusually long Y/Z dimensions valid even
    50	    // beyond CUDA's 65,535-block limits; ordinary benchmark shapes run once.
    51	    for (size_t z = zStart; z < nz - 1; z += zStride) {

    69	void initializeGrid(std::vector<Real>& grid, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
    70	    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {
    71	        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {
    72	            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {

+// X spans a complete warp for coalesced loads. The Y/Z tile gives each block
+// neighbor reuse through the read-only cache while retaining full occupancy.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY * kBlockZ)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                   Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx,
+                   const size_t ny,
+                   const size_t nz,
+                   const size_t planeSize) {
+    const unsigned int x = 1 + blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (x >= nx - 1) return;
+
+    const size_t yStart = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t zStart = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z;
+    const size_t yStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.y) * gridDim.y;
+    const size_t zStride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.z) * gridDim.z;
+
+    // Grid-stride traversal keeps unusually long Y/Z dimensions valid even
+    // beyond CUDA's 65,535-block limits; ordinary benchmark shapes run once.
+    for (size_t z = zStart; z < nz - 1; z += zStride) {
+        for (size_t y = yStart; y < ny - 1; y += yStride) {
+            const size_t index = z * planeSize + y * nx + x;
+            output[index] =
+                (input[index] + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1] + input[index - nx] +
+                 input[index + nx] + input[index - planeSize] + input[index + planeSize]) /
+                7.0;
+        }
+    }
+}
